entry.title: DeepSeek releases reasoning model with open architectural weights
entry.summary: DeepSeek has introduced an open-weights reasoning model that approaches state-of-the-art benchmarks on code and math evaluation sets.
entry.content: The new open-source model promises competitive reasoning capabilities with significantly lower compute requirements.

entry.title: Cursor AI launches team workspace features & enterprise security controls
entry.summary: The popular AI code editor Cursor now includes audit logs, SOC2 compliance flags, and team-wide prompt indexing.
